decision_conditions: This decision notice for Tree Works is only valid for 2 years from the date of this decision or until the work is completed, whichever is the sooner. Reason: In order to ensure that the work is carried out whilst still appropriate and in accordance with the time period within the legislation and regulations.

A replacement tree shall be planted in accordance with the following specifications: Tree Species: London Plane (Platanus × hispanica). Quantity. x1 (one) Size/Height: 14-16cm stem circumference at 1m, to be planted in accordance with the recommendations in British Standard 8545:  Trees from nursery to independence in the landscape - Recommendations (2014). Root ball or container grown is acceptable.Location: In the sae position as the original tree, or in an alternative position to be agreed in writing by the Council.Deadline: Within 90 days following the removal of the original tree, or an alternative date to be agreed in writing by the Council.The tree shall thereafter be maintained for a period of three years and in that time shall not be pruned or removed without the written consent of the Council.
